newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn hails end of Mobutu rule, calls for democracy.
newsitem.headline: Bonn hails end of Mobutu rule, calls for democracy.

text.p: Germany on Saturday hailed the end of President Mobutu Sese Seko's rule in Zaire and called on all parties to use the opportunity to establish democracy.
"The Mobutu era is at an end!" Kinkel said in a statement. "After 32 years of unbroken rule by Mobutu, the way is open for a new start."
"The new democratic start which has been made possible through the withdrawal of President Mobutu Sese Seko must be sealed with free, democratic elections," he added.

But Kinkel made no explicit mention of rebel leader Laurent Kabila, who announced he was taking over on Saturday, a day after Mobutu renounced power and withdrew to his northern jungle palace and stronghold.
The minister urged all sides to honour their responsibility towards the civilian population, avoid violence and ensure a peaceful transition of power without a descent into lawlessness.
